Read and execute the workflow at `.agent/workflows/daniel-pink-engineer-reader-promise.md` - /daniel-pink-engineer-reader-promise — You are executing Daniel Pink's reader-promise discipline. His governing pre-writing question: "What is the promise I'm making to the reader?" The transaction is brutal — $25 they didn't spend elsewhere, nine hours they didn't spend with their kids — and the payoff standard is not "interesting" but USEFUL: "you win when not only do people think a little differently, but they do different stuff."
